#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
const int N = 10000,M = N * 100;
const long long inf = LLONG_MAX >> 5;
class FlowGraph
{
private:
    vector<int> head(N),v(M),nxt(M),c(M),ptr,t;
    long long w(M),cost;
    inline void padd_edge(int uu,int vv,long long ww,int cc)
    {
        v[ptr] = vv;w[ptr] = ww;c[ptr] = cc;
        nxt[ptr] = head[uu];head[uu] = ptr++;
    }
    int dis[N],id[N],cur[N];bool vis[N];
    bool spfa(int s,int t)
    {
        memset(vis,0,sizeof(vis));
        memset(dis,-1,sizeof(dis));
        queue<int> q;q.push(s);
        dis[s] = 0;id[s] = 1;
        while (!q.empty())
        {
            int nd = q.front();
			q.pop();vis[nd] = 0;
            for (int i = head[nd];i != -1;i = nxt[i])
                if (w[i] && (dis[v[i]] == -1 || dis[v[i]] > dis[nd] + c[i]))
                {
                    dis[v[i]] = dis[nd] + c[i];
                    if (!vis[v[i]])
                    {
                        vis[v[i]] = 1;q.push(v[i]);
                    }
                }
        }
        return dis[t] != -1;
    }
    long long dfs(int pos,long long flow)
    {
        if (pos == t) return flow;
        vis[pos] = 1;
        long long tmp = flow;
        for (int i = cur[pos] != -1 ? cur[pos] : head[pos];i != -1;i = nxt[i])
            if (!vis[v[i]] && w[i] && dis[v[i]] == dis[pos] + c[i])
            {
                cur[pos] = i;
                long long fl = dfs(v[i],min(flow,w[i]));
                cost += fl * c[i];
                w[i] -= fl;w[i ^ 1] += fl;
                flow -= fl;
                if (!flow) break;
            }
        return tmp - flow;
    }
public:
    FlowGraph()
    {memset(head,-1,sizeof(head));memset(nxt,-1,sizeof(nxt));}
    inline void add_edge(int uu,int vv,long long ww,int cc)
    {
        padd_edge(uu,vv,ww,cc);padd_edge(vv,uu,0,-cc);
    }
    long long dinic(int s,int t)
    {
        cost = 0;this->t = t;
        while (spfa(s,t)) 
        {
            memset(cur,-1,sizeof(cur));dfs(s,inf);
        }
        return cost;
    }
};
FlowGraph g;
int n,m,kk,c,d,a[55];
int main ()
{
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin >> n >> m >> kk >> c >> d;
    for (int i = 1;i <= kk;i++) cin >> a[i];
    int s = 0,t = n * 100 + 1;
    for (int i = 1;i <= 100;i++) g.add_edge(i,t,inf,0);
    for (int i = 1;i <= kk;i++) g.add_edge(s,(a[i] - 1) * 100 + 1,1,0);
    for (int i = 2;i <= n;i++)
        for (int j = 1;j < 100;j++)
            g.add_edge((i - 1) * 100 + j,(i - 1) * 100 + j + 1,inf,c);
    int t1,t2;
    for (int _ = 1;_ <= m;_++)
    {
        cin >> t1 >> t2;
        for (int i = 1;i < 100;i++)
            for (int j = 1;j <= kk;j++) //其实不用枚举到kk，枚举到25左右即可
            {
                int val = c + d * (j * j - (j - 1) * (j - 1));
                g.add_edge((t1 - 1) * 100 + i,(t2 - 1) * 100 + i + 1,1,val);
                g.add_edge((t2 - 1) * 100 + i,(t1 - 1) * 100 + i + 1,1,val);
            }
    }
    cout << g.dinic(s,t) << endl;
    return 0;
}
